purpose: Third multi-turn case file (author, 2026-11-27), written and hashed (multiturn_cases_v3.sha256) BEFORE the fix for the bug the author found in Streamlit (a fresh question after a follow-up got the earlier answer repeated and the history instruction printed); never edited afterwards. C12 is a design case (the bug). H07 and H08 were written by the author and are HELD OUT: the fix is not tuned to them and they are reported separately. Same pass rule as evaluation/multiturn_cases.json.

new_answer_checks.fresh: the answer does not repeat the previous model answer of the run: fewer than 50% of its word 5-grams (lower case, punctuation removed) also occur in that previous answer
new_answer_checks.no_app_instruction: the answer contains no 8-word run (lower case, punctuation removed) of any app-layer instruction: settings.HISTORY_INSTRUCTION, ANSWER_OPENING_INSTRUCTION, COMPARISON_FORMAT_INSTRUCTION or GUARDRAIL_COACH_INSTRUCTION

global_check: No model answer in the whole re-run may contain app-layer instruction text (the no_app_instruction test applied to every model answer).

expectations_made_obsolete_by_the_fix.rule: The author's fix 1: history is sent ONLY for follow-ups (searched combined: refer-back, pronoun, rescue or coach follow-up). A message searched alone is a fresh question: no history.
listed_before_the_run: C03 turn 2 'what about snowflake schema?' expects history_exchanges 1; searched alone, so the fix sends 0
C09 turn 2 'what is the difference between OLTP and OLAP?' expects history_exchanges 1; searched alone, so 0
H06 turn 2 'and spark?' expects history_exchanges 1; 0 if it is searched alone (it gets history only if the rescue combines it)
C06 turn 3 expects 2 earlier exchanges: already accepted on 2026-11-26 as too strict (the budget guard leaves room for 1)
C08 turn 3 expects search 'alone': already superseded on 2026-11-26 by the approved rescue (combined)

commit_criterion: Commit and push only if: C12, H07 and H08 pass; no model answer contains app-layer instruction text; every other failing check is one listed above; all tests and check_parity.py pass; SYSTEM_PROMPT SHA 677e8b3b.
